changes.text: Train skills with trainers for any of your selected classes, by right-clicking or hailing them.
Scribe spells for your selected classes before their required level. Spell gems still require the normal level.
See what changed in the latest update and browse previous patches while patching.
Added a Sell All button to merchant windows.
Fixed a client crash when summoning pets.
Restored stock item icons in Advanced Loot and the Pet Info window.
Added Always Loot and Never Loot controls to each Advanced Loot item row.
Advanced Loot now closes when the loot queue is confirmed empty.
Added Nightcap artwork to the game's loading screens.
